verdict.rationale: Qodo documents severity-ranked findings and says it avoids low-signal feedback. It also scores each finding's relevance from how the team handled similar past findings, and offers noise controls: a Minimal preset, configurable finding types, and dismissing findings. Deduplication of comments is never documented, and the false-positive claims are vendor-only. Missing for 10: documented comment deduplication, independent or hands-on evidence of a low false-positive rate.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer keeps noise low — few false positives, deduplicated comments, severity labels — so my team doesn't tune it out

citations.quote: every finding states what needs attention, why it matters, and how to fix it, ranked by severity
